headline: Recommended approval of sewer extensions on Arlington St. and Henchman St., at petitioners' expense.
summary: Each recommendation passed 2 to 0, with Vice Chairperson Satya Mitra absent. The petitions cover eighty-five (85) feet for 72A and 72B Arlington St. and two Henchman St. extensions of about 146 feet and about 40 feet. The committee also approved its October 7, 2026 minutes.
decisions: Approved the minutes of the October 7, 2026 meeting, 2-0.
Recommended approval of a sewer extension of approximately eighty-five (85) feet for 72A and 72B Arlington St., 2-0.
Recommended approval of a sewer extension of approximately 146 feet on Henchman St. for 1 Frederick St. and 114 Lincoln St., 2-0, at the petitioner's expense.
Recommended approval of a sewer extension of approximately 40 feet on Henchman St., 2-0, at the petitioner's expense.

Important Notice: Residents are advised of an ongoing scam involving the impersonation 
of city officials and departments. Scammers are fraudulently requesting payments be 
made for planning and zoning permits, as well as City Council petitions. All official 
emails regarding your petition will come exclusively from an @worcesterma.gov email 
address (such as clerk @worcesterma.gov), or via physical mail on the City of 
Worcester’s official letterhead. Any legitimate hearing letter will always include your 
specific application details, along with the scheduled hearing date, time, and location . 
The City of Worcester will never request payments via wire transfer.
